grouping.limitation: An episode-only split does not establish generalization to new collection sessions or layouts.
grouping.method: Seeded per-stratum shuffle for singleton episodes; deterministic whole-group greedy target-distance selection otherwise; groups are never split.

label_overrides.reference_frame: Initial target position within the visible table/workspace from the recorded robot-camera view. Front is the near side closest to the robot/camera. Left/right follow the visible workspace layout, not the other box and not a hard split at the image center.
